title: Gyst shared definitions
description: Shared primitives for the v0 envelope schemas. Nothing here is a standalone document.

SchemaVersion.description: Envelope schema version. Consumers must reject unknown major versions rather than guessing.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, always with an explicit offset.

Digest.description: Content digest. Absent whenever effective policy is 'exclude' or 'metadata'.

NativeVersion.description: The source system's own version identifier. A source locator plus native version identifies source state (architecture.md invariants). Gyst never invents this.

scheme.description: 'none' means the source exposes no version concept; ordering then depends on observed_at alone and must be treated as weak evidence.

Location.description: Where a version was physically seen. Immutable once observed.

locator.description: Source-native locator: a repo-relative path, a provider item id, a workbook sheet range. Not assumed to be a filesystem path.

Confidence.description: Explicit uncertainty. 1.0 is reserved for directly observed fact; any inference must be below it.

PolicyContext.description: The effective policy under which this record was produced. Recorded so a later policy change is visible as a change rather than silently reinterpreting history.

Visibility.description: Derived from source permissions at observation time. Connector reach and viewer visibility are separate checks (design-round-2 section 5); this field carries the second one.

source_acl_complete.description: False when the connector could not fully enumerate source permissions. Derived data must fail closed when this is false.

Evidence.description: Observations supporting a derived record. Required and non-empty: a derived entity that cannot cite evidence must not exist.

AssertionPrecedence.description: Membership and grouping evidence precedence, highest first (design-round-2 section 2). A lower-precedence rule must never overwrite a higher one.
